title: Red panda waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Waving arm -->
  <g transform="rotate(-28 74 52)">
    <rect x="68" y="30" width="10" height="24" rx="4" fill="#d94f1e"/>
    <ellipse cx="73" cy="30" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#f58a35"/>
    <ellipse cx="73" cy="30" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffb47a"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#c9431a"/>
  <!-- Chest patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="12" ry="14" fill="#e86a2e"/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <rect x="24" y="60" width="9" height="20" rx="4" fill="#b83a15" transform="rotate(15 28 70)"/>
  <!-- Left arm paw -->
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="80" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#f58a35"/>
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="80" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffb47a"/>
  <!-- Right arm (lowered) -->
  <rect x="64" y="62" width="9" height="18" rx="4" fill="#b83a15" transform="rotate(-10 68 70)"/>
  <!-- Right arm paw -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="80" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#f58a35"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="80" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffb47a"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="24" fill="#d94f1e"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="20" r="10" fill="#c9431a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="20" r="6" fill="#f58a35"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="20" r="3.5" fill="#ffb47a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="20" r="10" fill="#c9431a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="20" r="6" fill="#f58a35"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="20" r="3.5" fill="#ffb47a"/>
  <!-- Face white patches -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="45" rx="11" ry="12" fill="#f5ede0"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="45" rx="11" ry="12" fill="#f5ede0"/>
  <!-- Forehead stripe -->
  <path d="M50 18 Q54 30 50 38 Q46 30 50 18Z" fill="#8b2e10"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="43" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#3a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="41.5" r="1.5" fill="#f5ede0"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="43" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#3a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="41.5" r="1.5" fill="#f5ede0"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#3a1a0a"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M50 52.5 Q46 56 44 54" stroke="#3a1a0a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 52.5 Q54 56 56 54" stroke="#3a1a0a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="31" cy="49" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9e7a"/>
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="49" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9e7a"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="90" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#8b2e10"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="89" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#f58a35"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="90" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#8b2e10"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="89" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#f58a35"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M28 85 Q10 88 8 72 Q6 58 18 55" stroke="#c9431a" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M18 60 Q14 70 20 78" stroke="#8b2e10" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M24 56 Q22 62 26 68" stroke="#8b2e10" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
